spec.title: First-7-day activation funnel by signup week
spec.question: Where do new members drop off in their first 7 days?
spec.sql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT signup_week AS cohort, board_state, connected_state, post_state, received_state FROM d_member_first_week
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ALL', board_state, connected_state, post_state, received_state FROM d_member_first_week
)
SELECT cohort, 1 AS step_no, 'Signed up' AS step_name, count(*) AS reached, 0 AS unknown, count(*) AS eligible FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 2, 'Joined a board', sum(board_state = 'reached'), 0, count(*) FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 3, 'Connected with others', sum(connected_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(board_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 4, 'First post', sum(post_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(connected_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 5, 'Got a reaction', sum(received_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(post_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort, step_no
definition: Population
Members at least 7 days past signup (signup week starts Monday)
Steps
Signed up → joined a board → shared a board with another member → first post → another member commented on or liked their post
Window
Every step within 7 days of signup, after the previous step
Denominator
Members who reached the previous step
caveats: Members who only read are not counted as active
c

spec.title: Weekly retention by first-week connection
spec.question: Do members who connect with others in their first 7 days stay longer than those who do not?
spec.sql:
WITH periods(period) AS (VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5), (6), (7), (8)),
base AS (
  SELECT member_id, signup_week AS cohort, signup_at,
         CASE connected_state WHEN 'reached' THEN 'connected' ELSE 'unconnected' END AS series
  FROM d_member_first_week
  WHERE board_state = 'reached'
)
SELECT b.cohort, b.series, p.period,
       sum(w.member_id IS NOT NULL) AS numerator,
       count(*) AS denominator
FROM base b
JOIN periods p
  ON strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', b.signup_at, '+' || (7 * (p.period + 1)) || ' days') || substr(b.signup_at, 20) <= :as_of
LEFT JOIN d_member_activity_week w
  ON w.member_id = b.member_id AND w.life_week = p.period AND w.any_cnt > 0
GROUP BY b.cohort, b.series, p.period
ORDER BY b.cohort, b.series, p.period
definition: Population
Members who joined a board within 7 days of signup
Groups
connected: shared a board with another member within 7 days / unconnected: did not
Retention
Wn = at least one post, comment or like in days [7n, 7n+7) after signup
Denominator
Only members whose window has fully passed by the cutoff (observable)
caveats: Selection bias: members who are more active in their first week also connect more easily
Members who left are kept in the denominator and counted as inactive
c

spec.title: 7-day board join rate by signup week (last 12 weeks)
spec.question: What is the 7-day board join rate for the last 12 complete signup weeks?
spec.sql:
SELECT signup_week AS x,
       sum(board_state = 'reached') AS numerator,
       count(*) AS denominator
FROM d_member_first_week
-- Signup week W is complete when W + 14 days ≤ cutoff: every signup in it has a full 7-day window
WHERE signup_week <= date(:as_of, '-14 days', 'weekday 0', '-6 days')
  AND signup_week >= date(:as_of, '-14 days', 'weekday 0', '-6 days', '-77 days')
GROUP BY signup_week
ORDER BY signup_week
definition: Population
Members who signed up in the last 12 complete signup weeks (starting Monday), where every signup has had 7 days
Numerator
Members who created or joined a board within 7 days of signup

caveats: c

spec.title: Weekly retention by first-week connection
spec.question: Do members who connect with others in their first 7 days stay longer than those who do not?
spec.sql:
WITH periods(period) AS (VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5), (6), (7), (8)),
base AS (
  SELECT member_id, signup_week AS cohort, signup_at,
         CASE connected_state WHEN 'reached' THEN 'connected' ELSE 'unconnected' END AS series
  FROM d_member_first_week
  WHERE board_state = 'reached'
)
SELECT b.cohort, b.series, p.period,
       sum(w.member_id IS NOT NULL) AS numerator,
       count(*) AS denominator
FROM base b
JOIN periods p
  ON strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', b.signup_at, '+' || (7 * (p.period + 1)) || ' days') || substr(b.signup_at, 20) <= :as_of
LEFT JOIN d_member_activity_week w
  ON w.member_id = b.member_id AND w.life_week = p.period AND w.any_cnt > 0
GROUP BY b.cohort, b.series, p.period
ORDER BY b.cohort, b.series, p.period
definition: Population
Members who joined a board within 7 days of signup
Groups
connected: shared a board with another member within 7 days / unconnected: did not
Retention
Wn = at least one post, comment or like in days [7n, 7n+7) after signup
Denominator
Only members whose window has fully passed by the cutoff (observable)
caveats: Selection bias: members who are more active in their first week also connect more easily
Members who left are kept in the denominator and counted as inactive
